verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Devin can be invoked from Linear/Jira tickets and Slack/Teams threads, plus API integration for building custom workflow triggers, but there's no explicit mention of GitHub or GitLab issue/PR-based task kickoff in the evidence pack. Community evidence doesn't directly contradict the integration claims, only general effectiveness concerns. Missing for 10: explicit GitHub/GitLab-triggered task creation documentation, independent hands-on confirmation of these specific integrations working.
